headline: War on Drugs · Quantitative Proxy Series

items.title: 2002 Drug Prisoners (12.4x)
items.detail: 480,519 inmates in 2002 up from 38,680 in 1972 (Caulkins & Chandler).

items.title: 1986 Crack/Powder Ratio
items.detail: 100 to 1 federal sentencing quantity disparity under the Anti-Drug Abuse Act (USSC 2011).

items.title: 5-Year Mandatory Trigger
items.detail: 500 grams powder cocaine versus 5 grams crack cocaine for five-year federal minimum.

items.title: Cannabis Arrest Disparity
items.detail: 3.73 times higher Black arrest rate nationwide despite comparable usage (ACLU 2013, 2020).

sources: Caulkins & Chandler (2006); USSC (2011); ACLU (2013, 2020); The Original Power, §2.3.5
